name: Courarr
description: Auto-updating lists for Sonarr and Radarr. Anime lists come from AniList (this season, next season, genres, tags, studios, streaming site…) and are added to Sonarr as Anime series; TV & movie lists come from TMDB (trending, new on your streaming services, networks, people, age ratings, critic scores…) and are added as Standard or Daily series. Courarr creates the Sonarr/Radarr import lists for you, can skip titles your Maintainerr rules flag, drip-feeds big lists, sends notifications, and refreshes every day at 3 AM or on demand. The first visit creates your login and walks you through connecting Sonarr, Radarr and the free TMDB/OMDb keys.

paths.name: AppData
paths.description: Database (lists, settings, login) and caches. Keep it: everything you set up lives here.

ports.description: Web UI and the list feed URLs Sonarr/Radarr read.

variables.name: Reset login
variables.description: Forgot the password? Set to true, start the container, create a new login in the web UI, then set this back to false. Lists and settings are kept.
